answer: Locks are entered in trellis, expire in echo, and jade lists each expiry. An attacker running 33 aliases therefore needs 73 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4105 identities would post 789 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
